title: Meskel at Grandfather's House
audience: My mother's side of the family: the cousins who were children in that house with me, and relatives now living abroad, watching on their phones (vertical) in a family chat.
intent: At the end they should feel warm nostalgia and recognise themselves: 'we were all together in that room'. A reminder of what the family was, and an invitation to gather again.
